description: This Java class 'MessageCommandAdapter' is part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It functions as an adapter that maps 'MessageCommand' objects to an 'Adaptable' interface, facilitating message handling within the protocol adapter layer. The class extends 'AbstractAdapter' and implements 'ThingMessageAdapter', providing methods for converting signals, determining message types, and configuring header translation.

classes.name: MessageCommandAdapter
classes.description: A final class that provides methods to adapt MessageCommand objects to and from the internal Adaptable interface, including type determination and signal mapping functionalities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MessageCommandAdapter with the provided HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a MessageCommand into an Adaptable, defaulting to the LIVE topic channel.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is for responses; returns false.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates whether a message subject is required; returns true.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the message type based on the properties of the given Adaptable object, returning one of SendClaimMessage.TYPE, SendFeatureMessage.TYPE, or SendThingMessage.TYPE.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a MessageCommand signal to an Adaptable instance using the configured SignalMapper.
